fields.label: Action Type
fields.description: Resolved against the fixed allowlist in actions/registry.py. A type not on that list can never be created.

fields.label: Reason
fields.description: Why this was proposed, in the words of whatever proposed it.

fields.label: Proposed Payload
fields.description: Exactly what would be written or sent. Read-only: an approver approves what was proposed, not something edited after the fact.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Driven by the UCC AI Action Approval workflow. Never set directly by application code.

fields.label: Action Level
fields.options:
0 - Read only
1 - Draft only
2 - Confirm before execution
3 - Policy-approved automatic
4 - Prohibited
fields.description: CLAUDE.md §12. Level 3 and 4 are NOT implemented -- nothing executes without a human approving it.

fields.label: Idempotency Key
fields.description: Derived from action type + target + payload. Prevents a repeated click creating a second ticket.

fields.label: Sources
fields.description: The records this proposal was derived from, so an approver can check it.

fields.label: Rollback
fields.description: How to undo this, recorded at execution time while the information is still to hand.
